parsed.draft_response:
Thanks for reporting this, and we agree this should be handled as confidential. We haven’t been able to confirm data exfiltration from what you shared, but cross-workspace/tenant visibility of a shared report link is a serious concern.

We’ve escalated this to our security team for investigation. To help them assess whether access is crossing tenant boundaries and whether any actual report data could be exposed, please reply with the following minimum details:
1) Product/workspace/report type(s) affected (and whether it occurs for specific templates/dashboards).
2) Whether the receiving workspace is in a different tenant from the creator (yes/no, if known).
3) What the recipient can see when opening the forwarded link (e.g., actual data, partial data, errors/empty results, or only metadata).
4) Exact steps to reproduce (how the link is created, then forwarded, and how the recipient opens it).
5) When you observed it (date/time) and whether it was in production or another environment.
6) Any supporting evidence you can share (sanitized screenshots, request/response logs, link examples with any sensitive parts removed).

Once we have the above, our security team will review and follow up on next steps for verification and mitigation planning. In the meantime, if you have a safe way to do so, please avoid generating or sharing additional links that might expose data outside the intended audience.
